purpose: Make the agent responsible for the complete Git lifecycle of validated agent-authored changes under the standing model-owned acceptance authority.

pre_edit_check.dirty_worktree_policy: Do not overwrite unrelated user changes. If dirty files affect the task, inspect and work with them; if unrelated, leave them alone.

branch_policy.scope_rule: Choose branch names by requirement domain and module boundary, not generic git-flow stages.

validation_policy.delivery_record_head_policy: The delivery-record gate passes github.event.pull_request.head.sha and exact number, URL, state, draft, head/base branch, and head/base repository metadata to payload-history validation while other pull-request jobs retain the default synthetic merge checkout for base-integration coverage.
validation_policy.generated_report_policy: Global validation and quality reports are ephemeral outputs and must not be committed.

blocks: global report refreshes in content PRs
non-scope self-review or scoped-audit churn
unprefixed self-review, draft, or scoped-audit paths bypassing content-candidate validation
nested, symlinked, semantically incomplete, or automation-reviewed self-review evidence counting as changed-card coverage
standard samples without exactly three immutable-HEAD-matching snapshots per declared box, or residual closure evidence used for newly added cards
new or changed review evidence reusing an archived global audit, or any mutation of the immutable pre-cutover report index and its referenced legacy review records
empty, malformed, forged, deleted, renamed, or non-replayed scoped-audit artifacts, including unlinked files
swapped, incomplete, symlinked, or mode-drifted review authority templates and formally approved records with empty or duplicate approval evidence

candidate-queue or release-gap consumers counting templates, traversal, symlinks, incomplete records, historical approvals, dirty/staged/mode-drifted audit authority or approval/review/audit evidence, concurrent HEAD/index/file/corpus drift, forged current-digest audits, stale audits, or stale linked self-reviews as current authorization without proving one fixed worktree/index/HEAD snapshot, regenerating the complete current audit, and exactly replaying both scoped reports
literal backslash, control, or Unicode line-separator Git paths being rewritten or misclassified as governed evidence
self-review-only metadata drift from the immutable HEAD corpus
noncanonical or Unicode card-box paths that are not part of the governed corpus filename contract
multi-prefix content PRs without explicit handoff or residual-closure evidence
current scoped card-quality audit hard blockers, even when changed scoped-audit evidence was generated under older rules
current scoped audits replayed against a partial overlay instead of the complete immutable HEAD card corpus
changed cards without current schema-valid quality metadata
changed cards without exactly one changed self-review snapshot
changed card and self-review quality_metadata mismatch
new or changed self-review evidence without complete true answer and analysis reference consistency attestations
elimination runtime ID, preview projection, or answer truth mismatch
worktree-only validation without an explicit immutable head commit

validation_policy.no_remote_checks_policy: A pull request with missing or empty required-check state is not mergeable; local validation and PR metadata never replace exact-head required checks.

wip_policy.candidate_queue_remote_mapping: weekly health verification requires exactly one open draft main-targeting PR per active queue entry and rejects unmapped content PRs
wip_policy.parked_candidate_state: closed PR plus recoverable patch_sha256 and original head_sha

merge_policy.agent_may_merge_only_when: the standing delegation covers the change class, exact-head required checks pass, and the base and target are unambiguous

payload_commit_policy.commit_sha_meaning: the final payload commit before the handoff-only commit
payload_commit_policy.base_commit: merge-base of the recorded base ref and commit_sha
payload_commit_policy.payload_path_set: all non-handoff paths changed from base_commit through commit_sha must exactly equal sorted unique scope.touched_paths, and every commit reachable from commit_sha but not base_commit is walked so add-delete, modify-restore, gitlink, non-UTF-8, and restored side-branch paths fail closed rather than disappearing from the final tree diff
payload_commit_policy.post_payload_changes: the full commit set reachable from the explicit PR head but not from commit_sha may change only the current handoff record; this includes merged side histories, and a later tree restoration or identical-tree merge does not erase an intervening payload mutation

record_object_policy.path: exactly one direct safe reviews/git_handoffs/<record>.json child, excluding only reviews/git_handoffs/TEMPLATE.json
record_object_policy.fixed_head_object: the explicit PR-head tree entry must be a non-executable 100644 blob; symlinks, executable blobs, gitlinks, nested records, backslashes, ASCII controls, and Unicode line separators fail closed
record_object_policy.read_method: resolve the fixed HEAD tree entry with literal-pathspec ls-tree -z, require the exact path/mode/type, then parse UTF-8 JSON from cat-file blob <object_oid>
record_object_policy.append_only: the current handoff path must be absent from both base_commit and commit_sha and added only after the payload; an existing base handoff may not be overwritten, deleted and re-added, or renamed into the current record, and all other historical handoffs remain immutable

semantic_git_reads.fixed_oids: resolve base, head, and handoff commit_sha to direct full commit OIDs once before merge-base, path, history, tree, or blob inspection
environment: start from an empty child environment
inherit only PATH, Path, PATHEXT, SystemRoot, SYSTEMROOT, WINDIR, COMSPEC, ComSpec, TMPDIR, TMP, and TEMP when present
semantic_git_reads.replace_policy: Git replace refs, GIT_REPLACE_REF_BASE, and legacy common-git-dir info/grafts must never affect ref resolution, ancestry, merge-base, path discovery, reachable-history inspection, tree mode inspection, blob reads, or patch hashing; GIT_GRAFT_FILE is pinned to the canonical null device and any non-empty common-dir info/grafts fails closed, including from linked worktrees.

touched_paths_policy.path_encoding: Git path output must be valid UTF-8 and is decoded fatally and byte-preservingly; any non-UTF-8 path bytes fail closed, and a leading UTF-8 BOM is preserved as the U+FEFF filename character instead of being stripped or aliased.
touched_paths_policy.path_discovery: Every payload and post-payload path walk forces --no-ext-diff and --ignore-submodules=none so local diff settings cannot hide a gitlink or invoke an external helper.
touched_paths_policy.git_pathspec_handling: All touched paths are passed to Git with --literal-pathspecs so pathspec magic and glob characters are hashed as literal tracked filenames.

candidate_content_evidence_policy.standard_unit: one changed self-review linked to one changed scoped audit
candidate_content_evidence_policy.model_owned_unit: one exact-scope model-acceptance.v2 self-review linked to one changed current scoped audit, with per-card evidence for every added or modified card
candidate_content_evidence_policy.fail_closed: missing, duplicate, stale, legacy-only, or scope-mismatched model review and scoped-audit pairings are rejected

patch_integrity.legacy_archive_policy: legacy hashes may be reproduced for immutable pre-cutover archive tooling only; a current changed handoff must never omit or downgrade the v2 evidence fields
patch_integrity.legacy_algorithm: sha256 of raw git --literal-pathspecs diff --binary <merge-base> <commit_sha> -- <sorted scope.touched_paths>
patch_integrity.new_algorithm: sha256 of the exact stdout bytes returned by scripts/validate_delivery_record.mjs buildPatchBytes for git-diff-binary-v2, using the ordered canonical_environment, canonical_git_config, and canonical_diff_options below before <scope.base_commit_sha> <commit_sha> -- <sorted scope.touched_paths>
patch_integrity.canonical_null_device: the platform null device returned by node:os.devNull
canonical_environment: start from an empty child environment
inherit only PATH, Path, PATHEXT, SystemRoot, SYSTEMROOT, WINDIR, COMSPEC, ComSpec, TMPDIR, TMP, and TEMP when present
do not inherit any other ambient variable, including GIT_* injection variables
patch_integrity.attribute_policy: Attributes are read from commit_sha via GIT_ATTR_SOURCE; a non-empty repository info/attributes file or any repository-local/worktree diff.<driver>.* config key fails closed instead of producing environment-dependent bytes.

compatibility_golden.fixture: the fixed text-plus-binary payload in scripts/test_validate_delivery_record.mjs
compatibility_golden.requirement: a Git/runtime environment must reproduce this digest before it may create or validate git-diff-binary-v2 evidence

locator_policy.pull_request: OPEN, CLOSED, or MERGED records use the canonical repository-matching /pull/<number> URL and require exact GitHub pull_request event binding for number, canonical URL, state, merged flag, draft flag, explicit head SHA, head/base branch, and same-origin head/base repository; fork records fail closed under the origin/<branch> model
locator_policy.parked_compare: PARKED_NO_PR_WIP_LIMIT records may use the legacy PR_url field for a repository-matching /compare/<base_branch>...<branch> locator whose decoded refs exactly match the record; the compare page is not a pull request, event context must be absent, and refs/remotes/origin/<branch> must resolve to the explicit validated head
locator_policy.push_ref: must equal origin/<branch> and be proven by exact PR event metadata or, for parked records, a matching remote-tracking commit
locator_policy.record_schema: current records require the complete template field set with strict string, boolean, object, array, timestamp, validation-entry, risk-entry, change_type enum, and merge_authority-to-scope consistency checks; content payloads use the same exact-head validated auto-merge authority as other governed change classes
